parole.significato: shiny, lustrous, glossy, bright (such that its surface, because of smoothness, color or cleanness, reflects light well)
parole.testo: From the same source as spīdēt (“to shine”) (q.v.): a stem *spīd-, probably borrowed from Iranian, nasalized in Baltic to *spīnd-; its ablaut alternants *spend-, *spand- yielded *spuod-, hence dialectal spods and, with an extra r, standard spodrs.
